resources.assets:6452.name: E Weakling
resources.assets:6452.description: Peasants equipped with clubs. Not an enemy to worry about, unless they appear in bigger numbers.

resources.assets:5068.name: E Archer
resources.assets:5068.description: Archers shoot arrows from afar. Quite strong when left uncontested. Weak against buildings and towers.

resources.assets:6451.name: E Ogre
resources.assets:6451.description: Ogres are huge melee warriors that really pack a punch. Hey! Due to their human heritage, ogres aren't monsters though (everybody knows that, duh).

resources.assets:6457.name: E Melee
resources.assets:6457.description: Swordsmen are simple melee warriors, but do not underestimate them when they come in numbers.

resources.assets:6458.name: E Hunterling
resources.assets:6458.description: Hunterlings are incredibly fast and dangerous monsters with the sole aim of chasing you down. They can smell your royal blood all across the entire kingdom.

resources.assets:6459.name: E Racer
resources.assets:6459.description: Racers are fast rolling monsters that are not messing around. They aim right for your castle center and are somewhat armored against attacks from the player character.

resources.assets:5069.name: E Flyer
resources.assets:5069.description: Wasps are flying monsters eager to destroy every single one of your economic buildings.

resources.assets:5076.name: E Catapult
resources.assets:5076.description: Catapults are siege units that deal massive damage to your buildings from afar. Your only chance is to get close and destroy them before they demolish your walls.

resources.assets:6455.name: E Monster Rider
resources.assets:6455.description: Monster riders are fast and durable melee warriors. A man meets monster synergy that should not be underestimated.

resources.assets:6470.name: E Exploder
resources.assets:6470.description: Exploders are monsters that roll straight for the closest building and explode when they die. They are slightly armored against attacks from the player character.

resources.assets:6449.name: E Slime
resources.assets:6449.description: Slimes are small melee monsters without much brain so they will just attack whatever is closest to them. They usually appear in groups which makes them vulnerable against splash damage.

resources.assets:5071.name: E Crossbow
resources.assets:5071.description: Master Crossbowmen deal massive amounts of damage to you and your units. Best to keep yourself and your troops entirely out of range whenever you can. They are quite weak against buildings though.

resources.assets:5072.name: E Ram
resources.assets:5072.description: Rams are siege units with a ton of health looking to tear down your walls and buildings. Furthermore, they are armored against ranged attacks.

resources.assets:6448.name: E StrongSlime
resources.assets:6448.description: Spiky Slimes are small melee monsters without much brain so they will just attack whatever is closest to them. They usually appear in groups which makes them vulnerable against splash damage. Spiky slimes have more health and attack damage than normal slimes.

level7:404.name: BOSS FIGHT
level7:404.description: Some people saw shadows moving in the water a few days ago. Nobody believed them.

resources.assets:6473.name: E LongSpear
resources.assets:6473.description: Equipped with long spears. Your horse is slowed and you take additional damage when riding into them, even more so when galloping. Better try to stay out of their range.

resources.assets:5073.name: E Fury
resources.assets:5073.description: A large flying monster that focusses on destroying your defenses. Their projectiles are quite slow and easy to dodge but wreak havoc when they hit.

resources.assets:6467.name: E BarrelKnight
resources.assets:6467.description: An enchanted warrior made of wood. Counts as a siege weapon and is armored against ranged attacks. Quite sturdy and eager to cause trouble.

resources.assets:5067.name: E Flying Wizzard
resources.assets:5067.description: Shoots magical projectiles that deal splash damage. Prefers attacking your units.

resources.assets:6446.name: E Moleman
resources.assets:6446.description: Can tunnel directly to its target. Takes additional damage from defense towers.

resources.assets:5074.name: E Moleman Archer
resources.assets:5074.description: A ranged unit that loves playing hard to get. Takes additional damage from defense towers.

resources.assets:5077.name: E Quicksling
resources.assets:5077.description: A unique siege weapon that rapidly fires arrows at random enemies in its range. If you don't have any allied buildings or units nearby, it will quickly mow you down.

level9:14547.name: E Eldermole
level9:14547.description: Some speculate they could be part of an ancient defense mechanism? Maybe there is a reason this castle remained abandoned for so long? No... they are just statues...

resources.assets:6462.description: A Mini-Boss that can tunnel directly to its target dealing massive splash damage to its surroundings. Extremely tanky. Takes additional damage from defense towers.

resources.assets:6453.name: E Flail
resources.assets:6453.description: Deals splash damage with each attack.

resources.assets:6463.name: E Bloodwing
resources.assets:6463.description: Flying unit that loves the smell of blood. Chases your troops across the entire map.

resources.assets:6460.name: E Giraffeslime
resources.assets:6460.description: Has a slimy ranged attack but no brain. Attacks whatever is closest.

resources.assets:6468.name: E Flogre
resources.assets:6468.description: A giant ogre equipped with a flail, dealing splash damage around it.

resources.assets:6461.name: E StrongGiraffeslime
resources.assets:6461.description: Has a slimy ranged attack and a lot of health but no brain. Attacks whatever is closest.

resources.assets:6465.name: E Ghost
resources.assets:6465.description: Can pass through other units and closed gates. Prefers to attack towers and your castle center. Takes increased damage from towers but reduced damage from your character.

resources.assets:6472.name: E Thing
resources.assets:6472.description: A terrifying monster that can attack with its tentacles in all directions at once.

level26:3688.name: E Ghostqueen
level26:3688.description: Could this really be the grave of the infamous Elara the Vile? You've heard the stories of how she burned down entire cities. The guards claim to have heard a strange laughter from the inside the coffin. Probably best to keep a safe distance tonight.

resources.assets:6471.name: E Wheel
resources.assets:6471.description: A fast siege engine that deals some splash damage.

resources.assets:5070.name: E Iron Tower
resources.assets:5070.description: A siege tower on wheels that takes reduced damage from fire and explosions.

resources.assets:5075.name: E Windboat
resources.assets:5075.description: A high-health flying siege engine with a medium ranged attack.

level27:7200.name: E Iron Castle
level27:7200.description: You can see it approaching on the horizon, an iron castle on wheels. It can only mean one thing. The corrupt king has finally found you.

resources.assets:6454.name: E Fire Snail
resources.assets:6454.description: A slow monster bound by dark forces that explodes on death. Takes reduced damage from fire and explosions.

resources.assets:6464.name: E Dark Warrior
resources.assets:6464.description: Poisoned by greed and magic, these humanoid warriors are a nightmare to fight against.

level28:15578.name: FINAL BOSS FIGHT
level28:15578.description: While once the beloved ruler of the realm, he was corrupted by greed and power. You rebuilt the realm from the ruins his rule had left behind. The corrupt king is fuming with hatred and envy.
